sourceClaims: The pinned implementation exposes two-dimensional OpenSimplex2, Perlin and Value noise.
It exposes OpenSimplex2 domain warp and mutates the supplied coordinates before a subsequent GetNoise call.
SetDomainWarpAmp documents its value as the maximum warp distance.
GetNoise documents a nominal output range of -1 to 1.
